source.spec: Community proposal in issue #1004 (commit-series hygiene: split, secret gate, why-messages); the gap was confirmed, the issue closed because no code was contributed. Built independently from public primary sources; no code or text from the proposer's pack was used
source.build_pattern: Three deterministic stdlib scripts over read-only git (series planner, staged-secret gate, message and series linter) with blocking exit codes and pre-commit / commit-msg / pre-push hooks; rules cited to Git SubmittingPatches, the Linux kernel patch guide, Google eng-practices Small CLs, Conventional Commits 1.0.0, OWASP Secrets Management Cheat Sheet and GitHub's sensitive-data removal guide
source.distinct_from: changelog-generator (release notes from merged commits); pr-review-expert, code-reviewer, adversarial-reviewer (review after push); git-worktree-manager (parallel branches); security-guidance (edit-time risky-pattern reminders); env-secrets-manager and secrets-vault-manager (where secrets live, not stopping them at commit)
